title: A Syntactic Approach to Ulmer's Bialgebras
summary: Ulmer introduced a semantic notion of bialgebras that unifies a broad class of algebraic and coalgebraic structures. We develop a syntactic counterpart by introducing signature pairs $(Σ,σ)$ and bialgebraic theories $T$, providing a uniform language for constructing internal bialgebras in a $2$-categorical setting. For every bialgebraic theory $T$ and $Σ$-model $M$ within a $2$-category with PIE limits, we construct the object $M^T$ of internal $T$-bialgebras.
